findings.description: Bhasin et al. 2018 Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline (refs [1] and [3]) is tagged `mechanism_review` throughout. The rubric specifies that reference intervals and diagnostic thresholds issued by a named body (Endocrine Society) should be tagged `regulatory`, and endocrine.org is whitelisted at Tier 2 regulatory. The guideline is used here primarily to ground diagnostic criteria (264 ng/dL lower limit, two fasting AM samples, free-T measurement recommendation) — all threshold/regulatory claims. Using `mechanism_review` is conservative and non-misleading but is a tag-discipline deviation. Does not affect any numerical claim or HALT the report; noted for correction on next iteration.

summary: Section D passes at 96/100. All five high-stakes effect sizes verified against PubMed: TRAVERSE HR 0.96 (CI 0.78–1.17, n=5,246, PMID 37326322) ✓; Wu/EMAS n=3,369 T<11 nmol/L + free T<220 pmol/L (PMID 20554979) ✓; Feldman/MMAS −1.6%/yr total T (PMID 11836290) ✓; MacAdams 211 vs 449 ng/dL r=−0.78 (PMID 3083749) ✓; Kafel OPIAD 20–80% (PMID 39982737) ✓. No fabricated statistics found. One minor tag finding: the Endocrine Society CPG (Bhasin 2018) should be `regulatory` when cited for diagnostic thresholds, not `mechanism_review`; does not reach HALT threshold.
